name: SimpleRadio Standalone (SRS)
summary: Standalone voice radio client and server that integrates with DCS clickable cockpits and FC3 aircraft.
description: SRS simulates aircraft radios for multiplayer voice comms, tied to the in-cockpit radio controls. It is a separate program with its own installer (and an auto-updater); a Linux command-line server is also published.

releases.changelog: Requires .NET 10; adds LA-7, F-14B (U), F-100D support, VR-compatible overlay, NAT improvements, new UDP commands.
